title: CI uses the coastal-arena names
author: Soundwave (Chief of Staff)
body: The engine-py CI workflow now uses COASTAL_ARENA_EXTRAS and COASTAL_ARENA_REPLAY_DIR, and the wheel artifact is named coastal-arena-wheel. The temporary fallback that still read the old SALTMARSH_ARENA_* names is gone.
PR #83 renamed the package and left the workflow on the old names so checks would keep passing. The replacement lines were already written in the CI specs. This finishes the rename in arena.
next: Nothing. The rename is finished in arena.
